name: retry_fallback_orchestrator
invariants: The Provider Adapter remains single-attempt; only this boundary coordinates retry and fallback.
Request, plan, and every Provider result use the same tenant_id and config_version.
The first plan step is initial and matches the selected Provider; retry retains the previous Provider and fallback changes it.
Every planned Provider is an opaque member of the post-Policy Router eligible_provider_ids set.
A later step runs only after a retryable result whose error_kind is explicitly eligible for that step.
Success and non-retryable results stop the plan immediately.
Every attempt, delay, and Provider identifier is explicit in a versioned Runtime Snapshot plan; no hidden retry default exists.
Every attempt and final outcome emits structured reason and telemetry without Prompt, Response, endpoint, secret_ref, or credential content.
The online Data Plane path never queries Control Plane PostgreSQL or LiteLLM governance state.
Usage, Billing, Audit, and Analytics persistence remains asynchronous and never blocks orchestration.
